scope: Primary documentation reconfirmation; no live provider mutation or guarantee of a future event.

sources.support: GitHub documents automatic merged status when head commits become reachable from base through direct pushes or another PR. It also warns this can bypass PR branch protection; helpers require actual empty/inactive rules and unprotected branches, with no bypass.

sources.relevant_section: Get a pull request, mergeability and merge_commit_sha
sources.support: Before merge this SHA can name a test commit. For a completed merge-commit merge it identifies the merge commit; mergeability may be temporarily null.

inference_and_limits: This supports using a reviewed explicit two-parent merge object plus nonforce base ref update as a native merge mechanism only where current repository rules permit. Documentation alone is not evidence that PR209 merged or that a future indirect-merge event will carry a particular SHA. Completion must wait for actual closed/merged state, exact merge_commit_sha, actual parents/tree/body/QUEUE readbacks and fresh publication/tracker verification. A delayed/unknown event requires read-only reconciliation.
